india_context.procedural_notes: Under Bharatiya Sakshya Adhiniyam 2023 (BSA) Section 63 (corresponding to Section 65B of Indian Evidence Act), electronic records require mandatory certificate by person in management/control of device.
india_context.transitional_notes: Events occurring prior to 1 July 2024 continue to be governed by Indian Evidence Act 1872 under criminal/evidence transition rules.
verification_requirements: Check that electronic email and WhatsApp timelines have corresponding Section 63 BSA certificates.
